findings.description: The Lambda function embeds an AWS access key and secret key as plaintext environment variables. Lambda environment variables are stored and displayed in cleartext (visible via the console, API, and Terraform state), so these long-lived credentials are exposed to anyone with read access to the function configuration and can be used to authenticate to AWS.

The function uses the nodejs12.x runtime, which is end-of-life and no longer receives security patches from AWS. Running an unmaintained runtime leaves known vulnerabilities unpatched and can prevent the use of Lambda's managed security controls.
